>> Commit in tyndur.git:refs/heads/master 'hdaudio: Set the right format for the output stream' (Kevin Wolf)
! So far we only set the format for the output widget. The stream must have the same format set.
>> Commit in tyndur.git:refs/heads/master 'hdaudio: Set EAPD bit for all widgets' (Kevin Wolf)
+ This is the "External Amplifier Power Down" flag and a 1 must be written to power the amplifier up.
>> Commit in tyndur.git:refs/heads/master 'hdaudio: Power up audio function and all widgets' (Kevin Wolf)
+ Widgets that aren't fully powered stay silent. So power them up.
>> Commit in tyndur.git:refs/heads/master 'hdaudio: Fix hda_set_volume() scaling' (Kevin Wolf)

! hda_set_volume() scaled the volume (which is between 0 and 255 in the CDI interface) to something between 0 and 127. That's not generally what the hardware wants. The number of "steps" are given in the amplifier capabilities parameter and this is what we need to scale to.
>> Commit in tyndur.git:refs/heads/master 'hdaudio: Enable output pins' (Kevin Wolf)

+ While enumerating widgets, don't only consider output widgets (i.e. DACs), but also output pins (i.e. the jack or internal device wherer the sound actually goes). We need to enable the output there.
>> Commit in tyndur.git:refs/heads/master 'hdaudio: Debug output for every widget' (Kevin Wolf)
+ Even for non-output widgets, gather some data and print it in debug mode.
>> Commit in tyndur.git:refs/heads/master 'hdaudio: Extract widget_init()' (Kevin Wolf)
* The code now continues iterating over all widgets even if it already found an output widget. That is exactly what it should be doing.
>> Commit in tyndur.git:refs/heads/master 'hdaudio: Skip non-audio function groups' (Kevin Wolf)
>> Commit in tyndur.git:refs/heads/master 'hdaudio: Fix use of wrong loop counter' (Kevin Wolf)
